khaos_15_20.entry: Open /dungeon to select this dungeon, or use the random dungeon queue. Confirm your role when your party leader starts a ready check.

the_deepworks_30.entry: Native puzzles and shared checkpoints remain part of the run. Difficulty follows the entering group average, rounded to the nearest level and fixed for that run; each extra player adds 10% enemy health, without a party-size damage bonus.
the_deepworks_30.rewards: Rift Haven equipment follows the run’s fixed entering-group average level. Native encounter drops remain part of the dungeon; inspect each reward in game for its exact stats.
